description:
Based on the erotic doujin game by Peperoncino (ぺぺろんちーの).

In this world, there are evil monsters called goblins. They are lowly demons that can be found everywhere......, at least that's how they are perceived by humans. They attack people, kidnap women, rape them, impregnate them, and reproduce repeatedly.

(Source: Getchu, translated)
